QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] I Am a Doll with No Feelings
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bAndroid #p2154007##k at the #b#m310050400##k in the Mine.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154007#, the mechanical doll with no feelings, thrives on bio energy. He says he has to steal energy to #bfill his Energy Cartridge, which activates his heart#k. This time, though, #p2154007# wants you to fill his Energy Cartridge for him...

#rDouble-click the Energy Cartridge#k in the #bEtc tab#k. #bThe Energy Cartridge will be automatically filled when you hunt#k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2154007# politely thanked you when you handed him a full Energy Cartridge. Oddly enough, it seemed like #p2154007# didn't really need to fill his Energy Cartridge. You were fooled...
